subject: Farewell: Ahmed Raza — Last Day 28 June 2026
body:
Dear Team,

Please join us in wishing Ahmed Raza well as he moves on to a new opportunity. Ahmed's last day with TechHub Pvt Ltd will be Friday, 28 June 2026.

We will hold a brief farewell gathering in the cafeteria at 4:00 PM on his last day. Kindly confirm your attendance with HR.

Thank you,
HR Team
TechHub Pvt Ltd

subject: Offboarding Checklist — Sara Khan
body:
Hi Engineering Leads,

Sara Khan will no longer be with us after 15 July 2026. Please ensure the following offboarding steps are completed:

1. Revoke GitHub and Jira access by EOD on her last day
2. Collect company laptop and security badge
3. Transfer ownership of active sprint tickets

Sara's manager should schedule an exit interview with HR by 10 July.

Regards,
Fatima Malik
Human Resources
TechHub Pvt Ltd

subject: Team Update: Bilal Sheikh Departure
body:
Dear Colleagues,

This is to inform you that Bilal Sheikh has resigned from his role as Senior DevOps Engineer. His last day at TechHub Pvt Ltd will be 5 July 2026.

Bilal has been instrumental in stabilizing our CI/CD pipelines. We appreciate his contributions and wish him success in his next chapter.

A farewell lunch is planned for 4 July at 1:00 PM in Conference Room B.

Best regards,
HR Department
TechHub Pvt Ltd

subject: Reminder: Q2 Performance Review Cycle Opens Monday
body:
Hi Managers,

The Q2 2026 performance review cycle opens on Monday, 16 June. Please complete self-assessments for your direct reports by 30 June.

Review templates are available on the HR portal. Contact Fatima Malik if you need access or have questions about the new competency framework.

Thank you,
HR Team
TechHub Pvt Ltd

subject: Updated Remote Work Policy — Effective 1 July
body:
Dear Team,

TechHub Pvt Ltd is updating its hybrid work policy effective 1 July 2026. Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with prior manager approval.

Please review the full policy document attached to this email and acknowledge receipt via the HR portal by 25 June.

For questions, reach out to Ahmed Raza in HR Operations (note: Ahmed will transition responsibilities to Sara Khan's replacement before his departure).

Regards,
Human Resources
TechHub Pvt Ltd
